a.title: Ronaldo stays on under cloud as Messi exits internationals
a.summary: Just hours before Lionel Messi played his last match for Argentina, Cristiano Ronaldo posted his latest salvo in a row with Portugal. Ronaldo wants to play on despite the troubles, while Messi bathed in adulation.

b.title: Messi weint, Ronaldo flüchtet: Das Ende zweier Ären
b.summary: Zwei große Nationalmannschaftskarrieren im Fußball gehen zu Ende. Doch während Lionel Messi in Argentinien als gefeierter Held abtritt, flüchtet Cristiano Ronaldo als beleidigter Altstar von Portugals Selecao.

a.title: US to livestream Army execution of Fort Hood shooter, Pentagon official says
a.summary: The US will livestream the Army's upcoming firing squad execution on December 3 of Nidal Hasan, who killed 13 people at Fort Hood, Texas, in a 2009 shooting spree, a Pentagon official said, in what would be an unprecedented move. Hasan, a former ​Army psychiatrist, is ‌set to become the first person to be executed by firing squad by the US military since 1945.

b.title: ¿Quién es Nidal Hasan, el exmilitar cuyo fusilamiento las autoridades planean transmitir?
b.summary: El exmayor del Ejército Nidal Hasan, condenado a muerte por asesinar a 13 personas en un ataque en la base de Fort Hood, Texas, en 2009, será el primer militar ejecutado por un pelotón de fusilamiento desde la Segunda Guerra Mundial.
